introHtml: Canvas lanyards offer a durable, eco-friendly alternative to standard polyester options. The natural fabric provides a comfortable feel against the skin and holds up to daily wear in busy offices, warehouses, or events. Choose canvas for a professional look that softens over time without fraying. Ideal for security badges, ID cards, or trade show credentials, these lanyards accept screen printing or debossing for a clean, long-lasting brand impression.
heroAltText: Custom canvas lanyards and badges with branded ID holders, ideal for corporate events and daily office use
